About Us

Technology has the power to open doors for everyone — unless it’s not built to be accessible.

About Us

We started CANAXESS because we believe there’s a better way to approach web accessibility.

Rather than focusing solely on compliance, we prioritise helping teams create websites that truly work for disabled people. By putting their needs first, we ensure your website is genuinely accessible.

With deep technical expertise in web development, we’re uniquely positioned to help you achieve accessibility in a practical and effective way.

Our approach focuses on accurate, pragmatic guidance, centred on the user. Simplifying the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) to make the guidelines easier for you to understand and implement.

Partnering with us means less time spent deciphering complex advice and more time creating accessible digital products that make a real impact.

Accessibility is at the heart of everything we do. We research, write, and present extensively on the topic, and we proudly consider ourselves The Web Accessibility Experts.
